The State Bank of India has released the SBI Apprentice Result on 25th August 2026 @sbi.bank.in. The Apprentice Recruitment exam was conducted on 11th July 2026 to recruit 7,150 Apprentices in different states of India. Thousands of candidates gave the exam to secure an apprenticeship in the largest public sector bank. Candidates can check the qualifying status by logging into the official portal. They can also download the SBI Apprentice merit list,result PDF, scorecard, merit list & check the next stages of the recruitment process.

SBI Apprentice Result 2026 Out @sbi.bank.in

The SBI Apprentice 2026 Result has been declared for the online examination held under Advt. No. CRPD/APPR/2026-27/07. Candidates can check their qualifying status and score card online through the official result portal. The answer scripts have been evaluated against the final answer key for the purpose of preparation of scorecards and merit list. The candidates whose roll numbers are mentioned in the merit list PDF are provisionally shortlisted for the Local Language Test and Document Verification round.

The SBI Apprentice Result 2026 provides important details about the candidates’ performance and qualifying status in the recruitment process. Check the table below for a quick overview of the SBI Apprentice 2026 exam cycle.

Note: This Result Checker is for informational purposes only. Candidates must verify their result from the official website, as the official result will be considered final.

SBI Apprentice Results 2026 Download PDF

The direct download link for SBI Apprentice Result 2026 PDF is now available on the official SBI portal. The official PDF of the result has the roll numbers of candidates who have been short-listed and are eligible for the next stages of the selection process. Candidates can download the PDF to check their roll number. Also candidates can check their individual scorecards to see their marks and qualifying status.

SBI Apprentice Result 2026 Out: Click To Download PDF

What Are The Steps to Check SBI Apprentice Result 2026?

Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the scorecard & merit list via the official SBI Apprentice Result login portal :

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website
  2. Click on the SBI Apprentice 2026 Result link.
  3. Open the result login page
  4. Enter the Registration Number/Roll Number & Password or Date of Birth
  5. Fill in the security captcha & click on Submit
  6. View the result & score card.
  7. Download and print the result for future reference

Check Out SBI Apprentice Previous Year Question Paper Here!

SBI Apprentice Score Card 2026

The SBI Apprentice 2026 Score Card will be available for download at sbi.bank.in. Candidates can log in to view the performance across Reasoning Ability, Computer Aptitude, Quantitative Aptitude, General English & Financial Awareness. Make sure to take multiple printouts of the scorecard as it is required during document verification.

Details Mentioned on the SBI Apprentice Score Card

Candidates must verify all details printed on their SBI Apprentice 2026 Result marksheet :

  1. Candidate’s Full Name
  2. Roll Number & Registration Number
  3. Category & Sub-Category (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS / PwD)
  4. State / UT Applied For
  5. Subject-wise Marks Obtained
  6. Total Score Obtained (Out of 100)
  7. Category Cut-Off Score
  8. Final Selection Status for Local Language Test

Get complete details on SBI Apprentice Exam Analysis Here!

SBI Apprentice Qualifying Marks & Cut Off

Candidates must get the minimum state & category-wise cutoff marks set by SBI to get a place on the official SBI Apprentice merit list

Category Qualifying Percentage Minimum Qualifying Marks (Out of 100)
General / Unreserved (UR) 60% Aggregate 60 Marks
EWS 60% Aggregate 60 Marks
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 55% Aggregate 55 Marks
Scheduled Caste (SC) 50% Aggregate 50 Marks
Scheduled Tribe (ST) 50% Aggregate 50 Marks
Persons with Disabilities (PwD) 50% Aggregate 50 Marks

What’s Next After SBI Apprentice Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the SBI Apprentice 2026 Result proceed to the selection stages :

  • Test of Local Language : Candidates must qualify the local language proficiency test like reading, writing, speaking & understanding for the state/UT
  • Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications, category status, age proof & identification of the candidates
  • Medical Examination : Candidates must qualify the medical fitness assessment also
  • Final Training & Stipend: Candidates who are selected receive a 1 year apprenticeship engagement letter with a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000

We hope the article on the SBI Apprentice Result 2026 was informative. Candidates can also reach out to us in case of any queries. Candidates can also start preparing for all types of government exams & get quicker access to any information through our Testbook App.

SBI Apprentice Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the SBI Apprentice Result 2026 declared?

Ans: Yes the State Bank of India has officially released the SBI Apprentice 2026 Result on its official portal sbi.bank.in.

Q2. How can the candidates download the SBI Apprentice Result 2026 PDF?

Ans: Visit sbi.bank.in, click on current openings for Apprentice recruitment & select the Result PDF download link.

Q4. What is the stipend for SBI Apprentice 2026?

Ans: Apprentices receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 for a period of 1 year

Q5. Is there a negative marking in the SBI Apprentice Online Exam?

Ans: Yes 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question are deducted for each incorrect response.

Q6. What is the next stage after qualifying in the SBI Apprentice Result 2026 ?

Ans: Candidates must appear for the Local Language Test followed by Document Verification & Medical Exam after the result declaration
